label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

SUPPORT_ATTACHMENT_STORE.note: Keeps attached files in the process memory, lost on restart. Not durable storage.

SUPPORT_MALWARE_SCANNER.note: Blocks only the EICAR test string and calls every other file clean. Finds no real malware.

SUPPORT_BULK_CAP.note: Batch size for a bulk change of support requests, so a journey can use the bulk bar. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_COMMENT_CAP.note: How many comments a requester may add to one request, so journeys can reply and J-support-public-09 can reach the cap. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_VIEW_PERSONAL_CAP.note: Saved desk views one person may keep, so J-support-public-10 can save and replay views. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_VIEW_SHARED_CAP.note: Shared desk views the desk may keep, for the same journey. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_MACRO_SHORTCODE_MIN.note: The shortest macro shortcode, so J-support-public-10 #7 can save a TEST macro. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_FEEDBACK_RATE_LIMIT.note: Help-answer votes one account or browser may cast per window, so J-support-public-01 #8 can vote and reach the limit. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_FEEDBACK_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS.note: The window for the vote limit above, in seconds. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_FORM_CAP.note: Live request forms the desk may keep, so J-support-public-02 #3 can define a request type with its form. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_FIELD_CAP.note: Live ticket fields the desk may keep, for the same journey. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_FRAUD_GROUP.note: The desk group fraud reports go to, so J-support-public-02 #4 can send one; the journey makes the group. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_ALL_GROUPS_ROLES.note: Every staff role sees every desk group, so the group J-support-public-02 #4 makes for fraud reports does not hide other journeys' requests from agents. Not an owner decision.

SUPPORT_CUSTOMER_SEES.note: What a customer reads of the desk's priority and type on their own request, so J-support-public-02 #6 can see both. Not an owner decision.
